subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood inference for MedCore Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Alan Pierce <alan.pierce@medcorehealth.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood inference for MedCore Health

Hi Alan and Samantha —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick executive recap and proposed next steps so your leadership and procurement teams have a single source of truth. I attached a one-page recap + draft MOA for your review.

Summary of business outcomes you described:
- Reduce extraction and coding time for patient intake forms by ~60% (current average: 9 minutes per form).
- Improve turnaround for prior-authorization bundles from 2 days to same-day for 70% of cases.
- Centralize audit log and data retention controls to meet internal compliance requirements.

Top pain points we heard:
1) High latency and failed OCR hand-offs when patient forms contain handwriting and multiple languages.
2) Security/compliance requirements around PHI handling and key management (must support customer-managed KMS).
3) Procurement needs a clear path for an initial pilot with limited risk and an easy off-ramp.

Redwood-fit notes (high level):
- Serving runtime: our runtime supports mixed-language documents and can run a hybrid pipeline (OCR -> LLM normalization -> structured extraction) with prefix caching to accelerate repeated templates.
- Security: Private deployment (VPC) + customer KMS are supported; we can enable audit-stage logs for the pilot.
- Economics: for the pilot scope we estimated monthly egress + compute ~ $X–$Y (see attached pricing summary).

Proposed next steps (I tried to align to what we discussed):
1) Redwood & MedCore to run a 6-week pilot limited to 3 intake templates and ~10k documents/month. Deliverables: accuracy report, latency summary, cost estimate for scaled deployment. (Action: Redwood)
2) MedCore to provide sample (de-identified) templates and a contact in procurement to start MOA review. (Action: MedCore)
3) Technical kickoff with your infra/infosec to validate KMS + VPC requirements. (Action: Redwood + MedCore)
4) Leadership check-in after 2 weeks to confirm go/no-go for full pilot expansion. (Action: Both)

Risks/escrows: You raised concern about auditability and a contractual commitment for data segregation. I noted two mitigations: 1) Private deployment with dedicated tenancy for the pilot, and 2) SLA/credits tied to uptime and data access controls (we can scope this in the MOA).

Attachments: Redwood_MedCore_Exec_Recap_20270420.pdf, MedCore_MOA_draft.pdf, redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx

If this looks good, I’ll loop in our solutions engineer (Aditya) to scope the technical kickoff and send a targeted discovery checklist for your infra team.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production LLMs

Hi all —

Thanks, Alan & Marissa. I’ll schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff for next week. Agreed we’ll scope intake templates + prior-auth packets. For the MOA and procurement ask: attaching a short tech brief and our sample SLA (see attached).

Quick notes on what I’ll cover during kickoff:
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (we will request required IAM roles and key ARNs).
- VPC: for the pilot we recommend Private (VPC) deployment with dedicated subnets for the inference tier; we can provide a simplified peering guide.
- Data flow: show end-to-end: upload -> optional redaction -> inference -> structured output -> S3 (customer-owned). We’ll include retention defaults and configuration options.
- Performance: expect median latency ~300–450ms per document for structured extraction with our batching profile (estimates will be validated on your sample data).

Action items I’ll take now:
1) Share the tech brief + sample SLA doc to procurement (attached).
2) Create a prep checklist for the kickoff (list of sample files, network contacts, KMS details).

I’ll reply-all with a calendar invite after Marissa confirms preferred times.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
